title: LLM Agents as Social Scientists: A Human–AI Collaborative Platform for Social Science Automation

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a classroom environment with LLM-driven teacher and student agents to test the 'Elite Hypothesis' in educational equity, evaluating whether a student's family socioeconomic status determines the allocation of teacher attention, and validating the results against empirical survey data (CEPS).

Simulating cultural dissemination to observe homophily dynamics, measuring how LLM agents' preference to interact with culturally similar neighbors (based on music preference, dietary habits, etc.) leads to local assimilation and global cultural polarization.
